displayQuote: Preach the Gospel at all times. When necessary, use words

meta.title: Who really said "Preach the Gospel at all times. When necessary, use words"? | Quotle.info
meta.description: No documented Francis source supports this wording. It is a later preaching maxim; Francis's advice to preach by deeds is a related idea, not this sentence

context.heading: Why it mattered
lead: The maxim appeals because it joins conduct with conviction, but the source question is narrower than whether its advice sounds good. The comparison with Francis's Rule ↗ identifies related guidance about deeds without turning it into the later words-only-if-necessary sentence.
